memory_candidates.content: When several orchestrated sessions share one Lean working tree, a generated-inventory emitter (scripts/check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory) and count generators (scripts/typst-status-counts.sh) rewrite files that reflect OTHER sessions' uncommitted edits too (e.g. a sibling directory README's line counts, the root README totals). Stage only the generated files in your own territory, leave foreign-territory rewrites unstaged and name them in the phase handoff; expect that a concurrent session's commit may sweep a regenerated shared file in first, and verify the committed counts rather than re-committing.

In this library a new object language inherits the derived-operator clause lemmas by instantiating TruthEnv with an INERT environment (register vector, admissible family) and the StabClauses/UntlClauses tier with every clause Iff.rfl; operators that change the environment (a binder) or the model (a propositional quantifier) simply get no abstract tier and a hand-written Iff.rfl clause lemma. Declaring derived operators as defs with the parent language's right-hand sides keeps simp-only lists matching the clause lemmas without unfolding.
